description: Built and maintained the SAT ERP integrator — connecting a sales automation platform to SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Sage, Epicor iScala, Odoo, and QuickBooks. Designed RESTful and file-based APIs for real-time data exchange with Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, and M-Pesa, across manufacturing, distribution, and FMCG clients.

Designed ERP, CRM, IFMIS, IMIS, and POS systems from the ground up for enterprise clients — covering inventory, HR, procurement, and financial reporting modules, with backend APIs and database schemas built on PostgreSQL.
